_comment: DigitalLocks risk weights. Editable. Sum determines riskScore; bands map score to riskLevel. Weights match the V1 spec in DIGITAL_LOCKS_MODULE.md.

timeWindows._comment: Local-time hour ranges, 0-23. `deepAfterHours` is the high-severity overnight band; `edgeAfterHours` is the medium-severity early/late bands.

thresholds._comment: Volume rule kicks in when a user's per-day unlock count exceeds BOTH the high-water percentile across all (user,day) pairs in the import AND the absolute floor (so a 5-event day in a quiet file isn't flagged).
